pr_body:
This test started failing consistently after https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/111744 was merged; the error is raised during test teardown, in the common cluster cleanup code.
The message/line number for failure indicates that a ExecutionException is thrown. Root cause is a CircuitBreakingException; it looks like the change exposed a hidden problem in the test, as the test was not resetting the cluster settings in cleanup.

I added a reset method to cleanup settings; I also cleaned up the test a little, removing some dead code and one unneeded class, and moved it to a more appropriate location/name (it is a IT test). Probably some more cleanup could be done, but I wanted to keep the changes down so I did the minimum to put it "in a good shape".

Closes https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/issues/111778
pr_comment: I added some comments to explain what is what and why

review_comment: Fix: we need to reset cluster settings after the tests, before the global IT tests cleanup; having a very strict circuit breaker during global IT tests cleanup will trip it and break the tests
This method was unused, likely a leftover from before adopting `TestTelemetryPlugin`, so I removed it
Cleanup: we don't need to subclass `TestTelemetryPlugin`, it's possible (and better) to use it directly
